purpose: Integrate V6 plans with actual source evidence, verify selected new datasets and produce a phased data selection roadmap.
data_use: availability and schema probes only; not admitted benchmark episodes
selection: Prioritize unresolved V6 benchmarks and long-tail modalities; no new model evaluation or formal QA release.
sample_rule: Aim for >=3 identifiable records/windows/scenes per accessible source. Not random or representative; event and quality eligibility separate. Unsuccessful sources remain in denominator.
authorization_basis: User requests actual source samples and now research/validation against V6; existing autonomous resource permission persists.
